title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hooks and metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds per-prompt regression CI hooks to the eval-harness and a lightweight metrics integration that emits per-prompt regression signals to the CI pipeline. Motivation: teams building prompt-driven features need automated guardrails to detect quality regressions at the prompt-set level before merges to main. This change implements: 1) a new per-prompt CI hook that runs a small sample of golden prompts with configured thresholds, 2) a metrics exporter that surfaces prompt-level precision/recall and aggregate quality deltas to the CI job, 3) integration with the existing GitHub Actions workflow and a new job that gates merges on quality signals, and 4) documentation and a small operator CLI for configuring thresholds. The description includes a short rollout plan and a checklist. Rollout: stage behind a feature flag, enable for a subset of repos (redwood, eval-harness) for two weeks, iterate on thresholds and alerts, then flip on for all repos. Checklist: - [x] implement per-prompt hook runner - [x] expose per-prompt metrics to CI via job artifact - [x] add GitHub Actions workflow changes - [x] docs and examples for configuring thresholds - [x] smoke-tested on eval-harness integration repo - [x] added unit tests and e2e CI sample. Related: ENG-3421 (prompt-set regression), ENG-3488 (CI metrics integration), SUP-1123 (customer hit requiring prompt-level alerts).
